programmes.d: This sometimes very funny and sometimes highly emotional anthology follows Garfield's nine lives throughout history, from his first life as a prehistoric cat-Neanderthal to his ninth life as an astronaut in a jam.
Garfield sits on Jon’s book and refuses to get up. Garfield thwarts a bank robbery.
Garfield's plan to send Nermal to Abu Dhabi fails./Orson dreams about the knights of the round table./Garfield lectures on what humor is.

Garfield is consumed playing a video game, while Jon is having a terrible stomachache. Orson can't find his spy novel and slips into one of his fantasies. The Arbuckle household is in distress when Jon's overweight uncle comes for a long visit.
Garfield imitates dogs and mice./The gang plays "pig ball."/Garfield climbs a tree.
Garfield discovers Jon’s new ventriloquist dummy is alive. Jon decides to take up skydiving.
Floyd, the mouse, shows Garfield how to get noticed./Orson dreams he is captain of a starship./Garfield tells Odie how they make dog food.
Garfield the cat daydreams that he's an old-time private detective.
Garfield tells the story about Odielocks, and the three bears./Orson wishes he had a time machine./When Garfield breaks his bed, Jon buys a new one.
Garfield tells the story of the Pied Piper of Hamlin, who has a cat.
Jon, Garfield and Odie spend the night in a spooky hotel./Orson tries to convince Wade that fortune cookies aren't accurate./On a hot summer day, Garfield brings out the Christmas decorations.

Jon gets a speeding ticket from a phony cop and decides to protest in court. Orson teaches Wade how by using one's imagination, anything is possible. Garfield is reliving Robinson Crusoe while Jon persuades a repairman to fix the cable.
Jon buys a new TV set when his old one breaks./Orson decides to make his own movie./Animal activist thinks Garfield is starving.
Mr. Swindler returns and gets Jon to sell the house for $1. Wade’s forgetful cousin arrives.
Jon gets to meet Vivacia, the TV horror show hostess of his dreams. Wade Duck is caught in a 60-minute style interview.
Jon gets an automatic dog washer./Orson gives a lecture on cartoon rules and logic./Garfield comes to the rescue when Cactus Jake is fired.
Garfield plays in an empty cardboard box./Orson's science fiction book inspires Roy to play a trick./Jon sends Garfield to a school for cats run by an ex-Marine.

Jon buys a washing machine that is actually alive and eats his clothes. Bo is the slowest cook ever, and Roy opens a fast food joint. Jon cancels all his credit cards and takes Garfield and Odie to the mall to buy a new waste-basket.
Jon tries to sell a story about a vampire and his cat./Roy holds a phone-in contest./Garfield won't chase mice.
Garfield is adopted by an elderly lady. Roy buys a robot that creates weather.
Garfield and his owner are in a rut. Jon cannot seem to get a date, until a school for the personality impaired opens a new window of opportunity for Jon, but is shut tight for Garfield.
The ancestor of one of the most hungry pirates sets sail. Philo is back to help give motivational speeches to the weasel and Wade.
Garfield and Odie trick Jon into not taking a trip on his vacation.
Jon, Garfield and Odie head to the Wonder World amusement park./Roy and Orson's brothers scheme to get the big award./Garfield shows some of his favorite exercises.
Garfield and Nermal are the finalists in a big cat show./Roy invents a holiday./Garfield tries to lecture an audience about himself.
Garfield and Penelope imagine what it would be like to be married.

Garfield and Odie grab the wrong shopping cart with a baby inside. Orson narrates "The Ugly Duckling" with Wade as the star. When the network asks for an educational segment, the Buddy Bears are brought in, causing Garfield to struggle.

Garfield accidentally winds up on an airplane going to the North Pole. / When the rain stops, Roy follows the rainbow for the pot of gold. / Jon has too many remotes, so goes to buy one brand new universal remote that will work on all his electronics.
In Frontier America, Jonny Ragweedseed and his cat make sure that ragweed will cover the land.
Garfield wins the hand of a Princess for Jon. Wade decides to shell himself up.
Garfield tests the audience. Orson offers his version of “The Rooser.”

When Jon goes to an all-night magic shop./Booker is irritated by his height./Garfield attempts to defeat the evil day, Monday.
Garfield inherits the cursed diamond./The farm folk decide to clean up the place, Orson's waller becomes a prime objective./While Jon hosts a lady friend on a rainy day.
Penelope falls for a hipper cat until Garfield learns to rock and roll.
Garfield wakes up to discover he's in the wrong cartoon./Orson can't pick up a book without reading it./Garfield and Odie stay in a ritzy pet hotel.
Jon’s niece has to be retrieved by Garfield and Odie. Garfield gets confidence from a motivational speaker.
Garfield lectures a group about a famous water voyage./Orson imagines himself a famous secret agent./Jon gives Garfield his "little black book" to hide.
Garfield tampers with the new talking scale./Booker's hunt for worms comes to a stop./Garfield's good and bad side battle for control.
Garfield and Jon try to help out a sultan. Orson’s imagination takes Wade and Roy on an out-of-this-world experience.
Garfield sets out to con a con./After an especially cruel trick Orson decides to get even with Roy./Garfield is spotted by famed film director Fredericko Fettucini.
Jon, Garfield and Odie audition for the talent show "Pet Search" in hopes of winning the $1000 prize and a chance at the finals in Hollywood.
Garfield's morning nap is disturbed by Binky the Clown./Wade accidentally pulls the tag off a couch pillow./When Garfield gets the Hawaiian flue.
Garfield tells of when an exterminator and his cat are sent to the Doctor’s home.
Garfield discovers a famous "haunted house" attraction is closed./Wade inadvertently defeats a local weasel./Jon discovers he is related to a traitor of George Washington.
Garfield, Jon, and Odie head out into the great outdoors.
Jon is harassed by a magazine salesman. An escaped saber tooth tiger switches identities with Garfield.
A criminal disguises himself as Binky to commit crimes./Orson and crew must spend the night in the old barn./Binky visits an operating room.
Garfield finds competition from a mangy stray./Roy's jokes become so intolerable, that Orson fires the rooster./Garfield buys a winning lottery ticket and becomes a millionaire.
Jon and Garfield end up in the ring wrestling the Masked Mauler. Leftovers run rampant in Jon’s refrigerator.
